acts.label: Prologue
acts.desc: Ira talks about why four conversations reveal how his relationship with his parents changed.

acts.label: Act One
acts.desc: Ira’s mom, Shirley, is invited to lead a discussion about how to get along with your adult children. Her adult children question her expertise.
acts.title: Interview One

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc: Ira asks his parents for advice on how he should build the radio show. His parents don’t hold back.
acts.title: Interview Two

acts.label: Act Three
acts.desc: Ira talks with his dad, Barry, about Barry’s own brief and doomed career in radio.
acts.title: Interview Three

acts.label: Act Four
acts.desc: An interview with Ira’s mom that, to this day, makes Ira’s skin crawl.
acts.title: Interview Four
